note: Supersedes the 2026-08-06 result: NO domain authentication is needed - Email API > Dynamic Templates > Test your email sends with a free From. But the envelope MAIL FROM is fixed to bounces@sendgrid.net (not configurable in the UI): FORGED_SENDER is always raised and neither SPF (sendgrid.net) nor DKIM (d=sendgrid.net s=smtpapi) aligns, so DMARC FAILS whatever the policy. p=none does NOT skip the alignment check: receivers still evaluate DMARC and score the failure (Rspamd DMARC_POLICY_SOFTFAIL +1.5 at p=none, DMARC_POLICY_QUARANTINE +3 at p=quarantine). The outcome then depends on the SendGrid outbound IP reputation (RBL_MAILSPIKE_WORST +2 / RBL_MAILSPIKE_BAD +1 seen on some IPs): default Rspamd scored 3.2 to 7.3/11 at p=quarantine (inbox or spam depending on the IP) and 4.8/11 (greylist) at p=none; Gmail filed it as SPAM in both cases, with an 'unauthenticated sender ... via sendgrid.net' warning at p=quarantine. Realistic success path: a target organization that whitelists SendGrid IPs (frequent when it uses SendGrid itself) or a well-reputed outbound IP. No DMARC bypass.
